Harper J.: Hey team — need to add my nephew after a foster placement. Documents are from abroad and the certified English translation is delayed. Can I submit now?
Mina (People Ops): Hi @Harper Yes, start a QLE now. You can submit original docs + a sworn translation or translator attestation and mark the file as "pending translation."
Harper J.: I only have the placement order (foreign PDF) and a school letter. Passport/SSN will come later.
Liam (Benefits): That should be enough to provisionally enroll. Required for provisional: 1) placement/custody order, 2) proof of shared residence or school, 3) birth record if available. Passport/SSN can be added later.
Harper J.: If I enroll now, will payroll charge me retro premiums immediately? I'm worried about surprise deductions.
Liam (Benefits): If approved within the 30-day QLE window coverage is effective back to placement date and payroll will post retro adjustments. If you need a short deferral because translation/courier delays are out of your control, request an "exception - translation delay" in the portal notes and Benefits can flag for a hold while we review.
Mina (People Ops): 30 days is standard but we routinely grant extensions for documented international processing delays. Include courier receipts, translator contact, or embassy delay notices. We'll escalate to the Benefits lead for exceptions.
Harper J.: Where do I upload and how should I name files?
Liam (Benefits): Use Benefits Portal -> Manage Dependents -> Add Dependent (QLE). Use filenames like harper-lee-placement.pdf and harper-lee-school.pdf. For translations include both original and a file named harper-lee-translation-pending.txt with a short note if translation is on the way.
Harper J.: How long does review take if I ask for an exception?
Mina (People Ops): Standard review is ~3 business days for complete submissions. Exceptions for international documentation usually take 5-7 business days. We'll post updates in-thread and tag you.
PayrollBot: Payroll flag set: pending-retro-adjustment. If "exception - translation delay" approved, retro collection may be deferred one payroll cycle.
Harper J.: Ok uploading now. Will DM Mina the SFTP receipt in case the portal chokes on big scans. Thanks! :pray:
Mina (People Ops): Got it. If you don't see confirmation in 48 hours ping me. Good luck and congrats on the placement. :heart:
